title: Beyond Static Charts: Benchmarking Interactive Chart-to-Code Generation for MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.31345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant progress in chart-to-code generation. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, overlooking interactive charts that enable richer and more expressive data exploration. Unlike static chart-to-code generation, which emphasizes visual consistency, interactive chart-to-code evaluation targets behavioral consistency, requiring chart states to evolve correctly under sequences of user interactions, thereby rendering traditional one-step evaluation paradigms ineffective. To address this gap, we introduce ChartInt, the first benchmark specifically designed for interactive chart-to-code generation. ChartInt consists of 2,779 carefully annotated examples covering common interaction patterns such as hover, highlight, and tooltips. translated_title: 超越静态图表：面向多模态大语言模型的交互式图表转代码生成基准测试
translated_abstract: 近年来，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图表转代码生成方面取得了显著进展。然而，现有基准测试主要聚焦于静态图表，忽视了能够支持更丰富、更具表现力数据探索的交互式图表。与强调视觉一致性的静态图表转代码生成不同，交互式图表转代码评估的目标是行为一致性，要求图表状态在用户交互序列下正确演化，这使得传统的一步式评估范式失效。为填补这一空白，我们提出了ChartInt，这是首个专为交互式图表转代码生成设计的基准测试。ChartInt包含2,779个精心标注的示例，涵盖悬停、高亮和工具提示等常见交互模式。此外，ChartInt还引入了诸如数据更新、样式调整和跨图表样式迁移等编辑任务。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向交互式图表转代码生成的基准测试ChartInt，包含2,779个涵盖悬停、高亮、工具提示等交互模式以及数据更新、样式调整等编辑任务的标注示例，弥补了现有基准仅关注静态图表的不足，并引入了基于行为一致性的评估范式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ChartInt, the first benchmark for interactive chart-to-code generation, featuring 2,779 annotated examples covering interaction patterns (hover, highlight, tooltips) and editing tasks, shifting evaluation from visual consistency to behavioral consistency under user interaction sequences.
